messages:
jordan: Midweek async check-in — SLOs / alerts handoff.
- What I did: triaged last night's prod error spike, narrowed to a noisy client causing KV-cache pressure; pushed temporary circuit-breaker rule.
- Blockers: need final routing policy decision for /v1/generate (region vs cost) and TTL guidance for prefix cache.
- Today: canary rolling deploy at 12:30 PT, running a 30m load profile after.

maya: thanks — can you paste the alert query you leaned on? I'll add it to the runbook and link the incident. :+1:

jordan: pasted below — it's PromQL: 
```promql
sum(rate(http_errors_total{job=\"frontend\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"frontend\"}[5m])) > 0.02
and
max_over_time(request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=\\\"1.2\\\"}[5m]) > 0
```
(we used the error ratio + latency spike to reduce false positives)

liam: i'll own the canary monitoring dashboards. Pinging @sam for an RC on the canary yaml (resource limits + burst policy).

sam: reviewing now. small nit in autoscale config (minReplicas). will push change in ~15m.

sam: also saw oncall-bot fired 2 alerts overnight for Redis evictions; opened INC-4321 and attached logs.

oncall-bot: Automated: Alert INC-4321 created by sam at 2025-11-01T03:14:22Z — https://intranet.redwood/incident/INC-4321

rachel: finance asked for a breakout of SLO misses by deployment type (Dedicated vs Hosted) for the last 30 days. who can run that?

maya: I can run the query, need exact metric names and group_by keys. rachel: last 30d, group by customer_tier and deployment_type.

jordan: routing policy preference: region-first, then cost-fallback, with a fallback variant that's quantized (lower perf) if capacity constrained. i'll add to the RFC draft later today.

liam: noted. i'll set canary alert thresholds to 1.5x baseline error rate and latency to reduce noise.

maya: quick PR ping — PR #6284 (cache-ttl-adjust) ready for review @jordan @sam

jordan: ack, will review post-deploy.

sam: LGTM, merged. :tada:

jordan: thanks all — heading off at 13:00 PT. if canary starts crossing thresholds, escalate to oncall and tag me.

liam: will do. leaving the dashboard watch on. :eyes:
